note: Privately operated campground inside the City of Bellevue's Haworth Park along the Missouri River: back-in paved sites on grass loops with scattered trees. Parts of the grounds are still under construction (operator, 2026). Dump station $10 for campers; $25 refundable pet deposit; check-out 11 AM ($10 late fee). --Claude
summary: Operator site read: Apr 1-Oct 18 season, water + electric (30/50 A) with no sewer, dump ($10), showers, reservation request form (site assigned on arrival), $30 30 A / $50 50 A - season, booking, hookups, facilities written manual; fees already hold the operator rates. Private gate passes (rate dated by 6/2026 reviews; site + phone; RV Life 8.29/70; Google 4.5/34). Not waterfront stands (sites 150-260 m from the Missouri across a park road and parking lots). Pin ~155 m off in a lot south of the road.
flags: PRIVATE GATE passes: operator rate $30 (30 A) / $50 (50 A), dated by RV Life reviews 6/2026 '$30' (A6) and 6/2026 '$50 for a 50 amp and $40 for a 30 amp site' (one reviewer's 30 A figure is $10 above the posted rate); presence = https://www.winsorcove.com/ + (402) 312-2170; RV Life 8.29 over 70; Google 4.5 over 34. Long-stay tests: no weekly/monthly rates posted and the five newest reviews are overnight/transient stays ('stopped here for one night'); the rules ('No window air conditioners', 'No outdoor rugs', 'No Construction on campers') read as aimed at longer stays but do not make it a seasonal park - pass.
OWNERSHIP private stands: inside the City of Bellevue's Haworth Park, but the operator posts its own rates and takes its own reservations.
PHONE: stored (402) 312-2170 matches the operator site (all three pages). Google's listing shows +1 402-933-3717, which the operator does not publish - keep the stored number.

WATERFRONT not waterfront stands, re-checked against a 7/2026 RV Life review ('It is right on the Missouri River'): the nearest (east) loop sites are ~150-260 m from the Missouri's west bank, with the park's north-south road, a long parking strip and the boat-ramp lot between; no site fronts the river. A view of the river from the east loop across open grass and scattered trees is possible but unconfirmed from imagery - stays down. The stored note's 'levee' between loops and river is not visible (the levee curves around the park's south/west side); dropped from the note.

PIN ~155 m (under the 250 m threshold, optional): stored 41.13300,-95.88300 is in a parking lot south of the entry road; the RV loops sit north of it. Mid-loop is ~41.1340,-95.8817 (RV Life's geoloc 41.13324,-95.88146 is at the loop entrance).
